newsitem.title: USA: E-Z Serve sells 37 stores in Florida.
newsitem.headline: E-Z Serve sells 37 stores in Florida.

text.p: E-Z Serve Corp said Friday that it has an agreement to sell 37 locations in central Florida to Island Holdings Ltd of Jacksonville, Florida.

The company did not disclose a price, but said closing is expected at the end of June. It said it would use proceeds from the sale to pay down a portion of its outstanding balances under its bank credit agreement.

"As with the previously announced sales of our gasoline commissioned marketer business and the convenience stores in Nashville, this sale further serves to concentrate the company's focus on its primary market area," a company statement said. "In addition, the company's financial flexibility is enhanced as its bank debt continues to be reduced."
E-Z Serve operates 667 convenience stores and seven franchises in 15 states, predominantly in the Sunbelt.
